signIn.resetSent: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.not_found: Not found in the current dataset.
errors.stale_cursor: The data changed while you were paging, so the list starts again from page 1.
errors.invalid_request: This view's settings aren't valid. Reset the filters and try again.
errors.invalid_query: This view's settings aren't valid. Reset the filters and try again.
errors.ambiguous_dataset: More than one dataset matches. Choose a market and scope.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.data_unavailable: The dataset is being updated. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.auth_unavailable: Couldn't confirm your access just now. You're still signed in; try again in a few seconds.
errors.internal_error: Something failed on our side. Try again.
errors.unexpected: The server sent a response this app can't read.
errors.export_too_large: Too many rows to export (the limit is 50,000). Narrow the filters and try again.

reasons.retailer_partial: This retailer is only partly covered.
reasons.cohort_too_small: Too few products to give a reliable number.
reasons.matches_unreviewed: The product matches haven't been reviewed yet.
reasons.no_match: No matching product at the other retailer.
reasons.not_applicable: This view doesn't apply to this kind of catalogue.

landing.subtitle: {retailer} · one snapshot, {date}
landing.compareNote: Comparison needs a second retailer or a second collection day. These cards show the layout they will use.
landing.indexQuestion: How the basket's price moves against the base retailer, day by day.
landing.indexReason: Needs more than one collection day; this dataset has one snapshot.
landing.gapQuestion: How far matched products' prices sit apart between two retailers.
landing.gapReason: Needs a second retailer; Ulta UAE collection is blocked.
landing.overlapQuestion: Which products both retailers carry, and which only one does.
landing.overlapReason: Needs a second retailer; Ulta UAE collection is blocked.

withheld.capability_off: Promotions are not collected for this retailer yet.
withheld.field_not_collected: Needs regular prices to measure discounts; this snapshot does not collect them.
withheld.cohort_too_small: Too few products carry both a price and a regular price to measure discounts.
withheld.other: Discounts can't be measured in this snapshot.

explore.title: Products
explore.retailerHint: Pick two to see the price gap. The first you pick is the base.
explore.gapNeedsPair: Pick two retailers to sort by gap.
explore.count: {total, plural, =0 {No products} one {{n} product} other {{n} products}}
explore.restarted: The data was updated while you browsed, so the list starts again from the top.
explore.emptyHint: Remove a filter or clear them all.

export.label: Export
export.overCap: Exports stop at 50,000 rows. Narrow the filters to export.
export.busy: Two exports are already running. Try again in {seconds} s.

product.missingId: No product was given. Open a product from the list.
product.early: New listing: not in comparisons yet
product.noOffers: No retailer offers this product on this date.
product.pairsHint: Gap is the other retailer's price minus the base's, on the latest date.
product.historyEmpty: No price history for this product yet.

compare.title: Compare prices
compare.intro: Two retailers' prices on the same products, on the latest collection day. Only exact, reviewed matches of the same size count towards the summary.
compare.pickPairHint: The base is the price the gap is measured from.
compare.convention: Gap is {other}'s price minus {base}'s, as a share of {base}'s. Above zero means {other} is dearer.
compare.noSummary: No summary: too few products are counted for this pair. The rows below show why each one is left out.
compare.equalCount: {count, plural, =0 {None at the same price} one {{n} at the same price} other {{n} at the same price}}
compare.sidesHint: Counted products are the ones in the summary. Products only one retailer sells can't be compared.
compare.count: {total, plural, =0 {No products} one {{n} product} other {{n} products}}
compare.rowsHint: Largest gaps first. Products not counted say why. Open a product for its offers and evidence.
compare.truncated: Only the largest gaps are listed. The summary covers every product.
compare.narrow: Filter by a brand or category (group the table, then pick one) to see the rest.
compare.noRows: Neither retailer has products for these filters.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.intro: Products sold below their regular price on the latest collection day, deepest discount first. A discount is the gap between the price and the regular price the retailer shows.
promotions.sharesHint: Out of the products with both a price and a regular price on that day.
promotions.count: {total, plural, =0 {No products} one {{n} product} other {{n} products}}
promotions.itemsHint: Deepest discount first. Open a product for its offers and evidence.
promotions.truncated: Only the deepest discounts are listed.
promotions.narrow: Raise the minimum discount or pick fewer retailers to see the rest.
promotions.empty: No product is discounted for these filters.

launches.title: Launches
launches.intro: Products a retailer started listing, newest first. A launch is the first day a product was collected at that retailer, after a day it was not; items first seen after an incomplete collection run are left out.
launches.count: {total, plural, =0 {No products} one {{n} product} other {{n} products}}
launches.itemsHint: Newest first. Open a product for its offers and evidence.
launches.truncated: Only the newest launches are listed.
launches.narrow: Pick a later day or fewer retailers to see the rest.
launches.empty: No product was launched for these filters.

card.empty: Nothing to show for this selection.
